newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seyang Shipping seeks court receivership.
newsitem.headline: Seyang Shipping seeks court receivership.

text.p: South Korea's Seyang Shipping Co filed for court receivership late on Monday after it defaulted on debt repayments last week, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
Seyang, a specialised lumber transportation company, said it was in financial trouble stemming from the financial crisis in the Hanbo Group.
Seyang's largest shareholder is a brother-in-law of the founder of Hanbo, Chung Tae-soo.
Seyang shares have been trading under the stock market's watch list since earlier this month. It last traded at 4,670 won per share on Monday.
